note: Curated buy-list. Prices are CNY estimates (educated guesses unless confidence=listed). Optional fields per item: target_cny = price threshold (dashboard flags crossed targets); checked = YYYY-MM-DD date you verified the price live (upgrades confidence to VERIFIED within 30 days).

items.name: AMD Ryzen 5 5700G (used, Xianyu) - 8C/16T + Radeon iGPU (VAAPI transcode)
items.why: Cheap AM4 core: 8C/16T runs Proxmox/ZFS/Jellyfin; the iGPU does VAAPI media transcode with no dGPU - heavy lifting lives on the BC-250s

items.name: B550 ATX board (used, Xianyu) - 2x M.2, 10GbE-ready
items.why: The core host only does storage/VMs/PXE - no GPU passthrough, so B550 is enough. 2x M.2 for the NVMe pools

items.name: 128GB DDR4 (4x32GB, used) - host RAM + future KV offload
items.why: Proxmox VMs + the KV/agent DRAM-offload lane (128GB on the host is where future cache offload lands, not on the boards)

items.name: RTX 3090 24GB blower-mod (OPTIONAL P3 - AAA/CUDA shelf)
items.why: Optional: BC-250s cover 1080p Sunshine gaming + all local inference. Buy only if 1440p/4K/RT AAA or CUDA tooling proves necessary after the trip - GPU-Z VRAM test before cash

items.name: RTX 3060 12GB (used) - anti-cheat direct box
items.why: Runs bare-metal Windows for kernel anti-cheat games the VM refuses

items.name: 2TB PCIe 4.0 NVMe (x2: VMs/models + game library)
items.why: Drive 1: VM images + model weights. Drive 2: Steam/game library - keep games off the ZFS pools

items.name: 8TB enterprise HDD, used (2x ZFS mirror pairs)
items.why: Pool 1: 8TB mirrored media/Jellyfin + camera archives. Pool 2: 8TB mirrored games/backups - 32TB raw = 16TB usable

items.name: 850W 80+ Gold ATX (new only)
items.why: Safety part, new only: 5700G + optional 3090 peak ~450W - huge headroom; the node stack has its own redundant PSU

items.name: Mesh mid-tower case (used / budget new)
items.why: mATX/ATX mesh - airflow over looks; the tower no longer hosts a 450W GPU

items.name: Tower air cooler (AG400 class)
items.why: A 65W 5700G needs air, not a 360mm AIO

items.name: AMD BC-250 16GB GDDR6 compute board (used, Xianyu)
items.why: Ex-mining PS5 APU: 6C/12t Zen2 (8C unlock) + 24->40 CU unlock (+1.54x llama.cpp pp512), 16GB unified GDDR6 @ 448GB/s. Node A = 2x planner, Node B = 3x workers + 1x flex (console/Sunshine or 4th worker) -> 6x ~81GB usable pool. Test each board + GDDR6 airflow before paying

items.name: BC-250 IO carriers: riser + boot NVMe + 12V feed (per board)
items.why: Each board IS a computer (SoC + 16GB unified on-board) - it needs a carrier for PCIe riser, boot NVMe and 12V power, NOT a CPU/RAM host. 6 per-board carriers; drop the old used-AM4-skeleton idea

items.name: Mellanox ConnectX-3 10GbE SFP+ + DAC (x6)
items.why: One card per board: the boards carry the RPC fabric (llama.cpp KV/tensor, PXE multicast) at ~1.1 GB/s; the core host stays on 2.5GbE. ~100-150 CNY/card on Xianyu

items.name: TP-Link TL-ST1008F 8-port 10G SFP+ switch
items.why: 10GbE backbone for Node A / Node B / core NAS - 1GbE (~110 MB/s) is too slow for inter-node LLM traffic; 8 ports leaves room to grow

items.name: 2000W+2000W redundant server PSU (1+1) + 12V breakout board
items.why: Sized for 8c+40CU worst case (~1.75kW across 5 boards); the toolkit-tested Mild undervolt profile (3.5GHz/1600MHz) holds 24/7 at ~1kW. N+1 survives one leg; load-test before trusting it

items.name: 12U-18U cabinet (600mm deep) + 2x 4U open-frame shelves
items.why: BC-250s are non-standard 305mm boards - off-the-shelf cases do not fit. Shelves hold carrier+switch+PSU; 3D-printed closers seal the airflow path between boards

items.name: High-static 120mm PWM fan set (Delta 4000+ RPM class) - 2/board
items.why: 2 per board x 6 (heatsink + GDDR6) + 2 cabinet exhaust; curves in CoolerControl

items.name: 2TB NVMe - KV-cache / agent scratch drive
items.why: Dedicated fast scratch: llama.cpp KV quant (q8_0) keeps caches small today, but prefix reuse, embedding indexes, build caches and future KV offload need their own drive - never share it with games or media

items.name: 3D-printed airflow kit: board shrouds, board-to-board closers, 120mm ducts + 6x PETG spools
items.why: Print your own closers/ducts so the Delta fans press air through the heatsink channels instead of around them; PETG survives 70-80C rack temps

items.name: 3D printer (Elegoo Neptune 4 class) - skip if you already own one
items.why: Pays for itself across the rack: shrouds, closers, cable combs, shelf brackets - plus endless home fixes for a four-family house

items.name: 1500VA UPS - NEW ONLY
items.why: ZFS and 24/7 cameras must survive outages; never buy used batteries

items.name: Used OEM tower (Dell/HP) for the 3060 box
items.why: Second physical machine - boots real Windows, no hypervisor in sight

items.name: Xiaomi Mi Box x2 (TV Moonlight / Jellyfin endpoints)
items.why: TV endpoints replace mini-PCs: decode Moonlight/Jellyfin at the TV (living room + main bedroom) - zero cables back to the server

items.name: DP->HDMI 2.1 dongle (Ugreen CH7218 PCON)
items.why: BC-250 is DP-only: the CH7218 PCON adapter gives HDMI 2.1 for direct-to-TV console mode (needs the toolkit CH7218 kernel patch + EDID override). Optional - Moonlight via the Mi Box needs no dongle

items.name: Wireless game controllers x2 (couch gaming via Moonlight)
items.why: Four-family home, two gaming paths: the 3090 game VM plus a BC-250 in console mode (SteamOS + bc250 toolkit) - controllers for every sofa

items.name: Premium wireless KB+mouse set (main stations)
items.why: Primary desks - smooth daily driver matters most here

items.name: Wireless KB+mouse set (light stations)
items.why: Kids/future tablets stations - cheap but consistent

items.name: 2.5GbE managed switch + Cat6 runs
items.why: Ethernet per room beats Wi-Fi for Moonlight latency - run cables before furniture lands

items.name: PoE camera set: 4 cams + 8ch NVR (local, no cloud)
items.why: Local-only recording kills monthly subscription fees - feeds the independence goal

items.name: 3-seater sofa
items.why: Heaviest line - measure doorways/elevators first. Quality tier beats local at half price

items.name: Service / coffee tables
items.why: Pairs with sofas; ships in the same crate - near-zero marginal freight

items.name: Kitchen accessories bundle (organizers, knives, utensils)
items.why: Modular: cut this whole line if the kitchen plan changes - that is the cancel-anything design

items.name: Bathroom accessories set x2 bathrooms
items.why: Fixtures, holders, mirrors - classic half-price China category

items.name: Art pieces + sculptures
items.why: Light, high value-to-weight - the cheapest freight per SAR of visual impact

items.name: Bed frame + premium ergonomic mattress + nightstands (Foshan Lecong)
items.why: Main bedroom set from Lecong market: frame + mattress + 2 nightstands. Large wardrobe deliberately EXCLUDED - floor space and budget headroom matter more

items.name: Dimmable ambient lighting (bedroom + living)
items.why: Bedroom decor bundle with the curtains: smart-dimmable, roughly half local price

items.name: Made-to-measure curtains (main bedroom + living)
items.why: Bedroom decor bundle: curtains + dimmable lighting together land at the planned 1,100 CNY

items.name: Bedroom bedding set (duvet, sheets, pillows)
items.why: Full bedroom bundle minus the wardrobe - linens are a classic half-price China category, buy with the bed at Lecong

items.name: Bedroom rug (1.6x2.3m wool blend)
items.why: Completes the bedroom floor plan - light enough to earn its freight share

items.name: Full-length LED mirror (bedroom)
items.why: Wardrobe is out of the plan, but a wall-hung mirror keeps the room practical for ~half local price

items.name: Robot vacuum (Roborock/Xiaomi tier)
items.why: Light electronics with no local price advantage - earns its freight

items.name: Smart home kit (switches, sensors, hub)
items.why: Feeds the local-automation goal; works with the Proxmox stack via Zigbee

items.name: Distinctive gadget bundle (Anker/eufy tier)
items.why: The little stuff that has no local equivalent - fill the crate gaps
